diagnostics.method: Joint withheld-sensor and withheld-period contrast checks. Exact truncated-strength predictive sampling,2048 scrambled Sobol draws/block; 1% familywise Bonferroni screen over checked blocks. QMC tail resolution and unchecked blocks are explicit; not field calibrated or an adequacy certificate.

planning_diagnostics.method: discrete-mixture group information; stratified scrambled Sobol integration
planning_diagnostics.target: background-only versus nearest-anchor geographic partitions; conditional observed-window model, not source responsibility
planning_diagnostics.covariance: callback conditional on observed data; Gaussian per component
limitations: Numerical group information under the supplied model, not demonstrated field improvement.
Finite component and integration budgets can change plan rankings; assess convergence.
Replicate disagreement does not bound systematic component-approximation error.
planning_diagnostics.future_instrument_ids: followup-{candidate ID}; independent new instruments unless this ID exists in history

observability.method: GLS profile over all source/weather configurations, fitting nonnegative strength and independent per-window background/trend.
observability.meaning: Compatibility uses delta chi-square4.605 as an uncalibrated diagnostic, not a geographic confidence region. Strength is effective Q/speed-scale at nominal wind speed and is unbounded; huge fitted values expose prior/identifiability sensitivity. Distant compatible cells can indicate global ambiguity. No source count or responsibility is established.

meteorology_evidence.meaning: Bias conditioned on user-supplied paired weather measurements only. Independence/calibration claims are not externally verified; shared upstream systematic errors do not average away. No pollution residual certifies weather. A station comparison does not verify spatial representativeness or clock accuracy elsewhere.
meteorology_evidence.additional_evidence: An independent co-located wind comparison or separating wind regimes may help. Pollution-site plans do not include weather hardware, deployment time or cost; budget any new weather instrument separately.
meteorology_evidence.normal_tail_truncation: Finite approximately±3SD quadrature; not a hard bound on real weather errors.
meteorology_evidence.inferred_correction_meaning: Pollution-conditioned offset is model inference, not an independently measured wind correction. All source/weather components enter regions and plans.

meteorology_uncertainty.provenance: Short-period declared uncertainty; persistent station accuracy unknown

interpretation: Numerical expected information about background-only versus coarse source regions (nats), under a moment-matched predictive mixture conditioned on existing readings. This is an experimental model score, not demonstrated field benefit.
warnings: SYNTHETIC investigation: simulated inputs, not field validation; row origins are preserved.
Experimental conditional scenario weights; no field-validated attribution or geographic coverage calibration.
Future scheduling is unsupported. Plans compare hypothetical simultaneous observations in the observed steady window, using its historical wind; no future observed weather is used.
A background-only explanation competes with one steady release. Multiple sources, urban transport and humidity response are not identified by this model.

INFORMATION LIMIT: nuisance-profile calculations find compatible explanations over more than 70% of the supported domain. Additional repeats in the same wind may not locate a source; compare feasible layouts or independently steady wind windows. This diagnostic is not a calibrated confidence region.

Campaign analysis assumes one fixed source and constant release across independently steady windows; each window has its own background/trend. Changes in release, transport or sensor response can invalidate localization. Wind transitions are not simulated.
Source location is not resolved under the declared evidence rule. Spatial spread remains available as a geometric baseline; neither plan has demonstrated field benefit.
